messages.onCommandOnly: `@{{decorator}}` can only be applied to a class that extends a seyfert command base (e.g. `Command`, `SubCommand`).
messages.onCommandOrComponentOnly: `@{{decorator}}` can only be applied to a class that extends a seyfert command or component base (e.g. `Command`, `ComponentCommand`, `ModalCommand`).
